content: Yesu ꞌina heꞌita ꞌoyai
Yesu boda madouna ꞌiꞌitediya, ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌebesinediya ma ꞌihaneya ꞌoyai ma ꞌimiyatoiya, ꞌoina, ma ꞌina tomuliyao wete sihanema.
Coinega Yesu ꞌihegaina ma ꞌiheꞌita ꞌoidiya, ꞌigwae:
Comi maꞌimi nuwadobi wayaliyaya, weyahina Yehoba nimana wamiyamiya.
Comi todou wete wayaliyaya, ꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌiheyaliyayegomi.
Comi ꞌimi mumuga nuhana, wayaliyaya weyahina ꞌabwa Yehoba baleꞌu mabwaiyana ꞌiꞌebwaegomi.
Ma ꞌeguma ꞌomi mumuga ꞌausalana nuwanuwami madouna wayaliyaya, beno ꞌabwa mumuga bwebweꞌana ꞌatemiya ꞌimadou.
Ma ꞌomi toꞌatemuyamuya wayaliyaya, weyahina Yehoba wete ꞌiꞌatemuyamuyaegomi.
Comi ꞌatemi ꞌausaladi wayaliyaya, weyahina ꞌabwa Yehoba waꞌita.
Comi toꞌabi henuwadaumwala wayaliyaya, weyahina Yehoba ꞌiꞌahwa natunegomi.
Ceguma ꞌomi ꞌimi paihowa bwebweꞌana weyahina tomota siꞌalehegomi, beno wayaliyaya weyahina Yehoba nimana wamiyamiya.
Ma ꞌeguma weyahigu tomota siloloheliwegomi, siꞌaleꞌalehegomi, ma ꞌidi ꞌabowega siꞌahwa galegalegomi, wayaliyaya tuwa.

Moisa ꞌilobwainegomiya ma wayaliyaya madouna, weyahina ꞌabwa ꞌami maisa bwebweꞌana galewa waloba. Ma ꞌomi gide Yehoba ꞌina palopitao mwalo. Weyahina taudi wete ꞌidi miya mwau silobeya tomota ꞌoidiyega.
Hola ma mayale weyahidi
Comi gide hola mebaleꞌu weyahidi. Ma hesi ꞌeguma hola ꞌina waiwai ꞌigumwala, geya sawasawahina ma ꞌibwebweꞌana hila, ꞌoinega talogwahate ma tasiwa yahule ꞌeda ꞌoina.

Ma wete ꞌomi gide mayale mebaleꞌu weyahidi. Ceguma mayale tagabu, sahena walata ꞌoinega taꞌahuꞌahu hetaluhi, ma hesi ꞌebe lagu tabwanina talagu, ma hada mabwaiyana ꞌiꞌasilala. Wete gide ꞌeguma ꞌoya pwatana taheꞌasa, geya sawasawahina ma ꞌasaina tadahwa.
Comi wete gide, ꞌilobwainegomiya ma ꞌimi ꞌasilala waꞌabi heꞌasilala tomota ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌoinega ꞌimi paihowa bwebweꞌana siꞌita ma Tamamiu galewa sihepwatuwe.
Loina weyahina
Sahena wanuwanuwatuhu ꞌabehega taugu yanaoma ma Mosese ꞌina loinao nuwana palopitao ꞌidi heꞌitao yaꞌewayahuledi. Ma hesi yanaoma ma ꞌabehega loinaedi yaꞌabilatuhedi.
Ma yahegwaegomi ꞌabehega loinaedi silatu ma geyaꞌabwa ꞌaigeda toꞌaha muhemuhena ꞌoidiyega ꞌisawala ma ꞌana siga galewa ma baleꞌu sisawala.

Ma ꞌeguma taiya loinaedi ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega muhemuhena ꞌilogwahate, ma tomota wete gide ꞌiheꞌitaedi, tauna Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌalona tauna toloduduna moisa, ma hesi ꞌeguma loinaedi ꞌuhematamatanedi ma ꞌuheꞌitaedi, beno saniu ꞌimadou Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌalona.
Wete yahegwaegomi ꞌabehega ꞌilobwainegomiya ma mumugami taudi Palisiyao ma loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ꞌidi mumuga ꞌida bwebweꞌana sinedi. Ma ꞌeguma geya, sahena Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina waluhuluhu.
Gamwasowala weyahina
Loina nugenugetana tubudao ꞌoidiya wasanapuya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Sahena loheꞌamasa, ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌiloheꞌamasa, loina ꞌiloba.”

content: Ma hesi taugu yaloinegomi ꞌabehega ꞌeguma taiya ꞌowa tasiu ꞌugamwasowale, ꞌabwa loina ꞌuloba. Ma ꞌeguma tasiu ꞌuꞌahwa galagalae loina ꞌuloba, toloinao ꞌoidiyega. Ma wete ꞌeguma tasiu ꞌana gwae mwauna ꞌulagu, ꞌabwa ꞌuluhu ꞌasa ꞌalaꞌalatana* ꞌoina.
Coinega ꞌeguma ꞌino pwaoli ꞌuꞌeweꞌeweyama ma ꞌabehega ꞌupwaoli Yehoba ꞌoina, ma ꞌeguma ꞌebwa ꞌunuweya ꞌabehega tasiuina ꞌinuwagala ꞌowa ꞌino mumuga weyahina,
ꞌilobwainegowa ma ꞌino pwaoli ꞌulagu ꞌebe pwaoli deina, ma ꞌuhila tasiu ꞌoina ma ꞌutoho ma baꞌidau walabina hila, ma muliyetega ꞌuhilama ma Yehoba ꞌoina ꞌupwaoli.

Ma ꞌeguma ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌitoego ma ꞌitauyego sabi heyatalaego, ꞌilobwainegowa ma nugeta puiina ꞌugihedumwalu mwayamwayauwe maꞌiyau. Ma ꞌeguma geya, ꞌa toheꞌewaina ꞌida tauyego toloina ꞌoina ma ꞌa loina ꞌuloba, beno silagugo deliya,
ma hesi geyaꞌabwa ꞌulatulatu ma ꞌana laba ꞌa buki mabwaiyana ꞌuhemaisa hegumwalidi.
Nuwatuhu dahwana weyahina
Loina nugenugetana wasanapu pwaiya, ꞌigwae,
ma hesi taugu yaloinegomi ꞌabehega ꞌeguma to loheya wahine ꞌoina ꞌinuwatuhu dahwana, tauna ꞌatena ꞌipui pwaiya.

Ceguma mata ꞌebeulauina ꞌebubunega ꞌiꞌabihebeꞌugo ꞌilobwaineya ꞌubwai yahule. Muya geya madouna ꞌeguma wahiu ꞌaigeda tuwa ꞌuloyahule, ma hesi muya madouna ꞌeguma matau weyahina Yehoba wahiu mabwaiyana ꞌiule suluhe ꞌasa ꞌalaꞌalatana* ꞌoina.

Gide wete ꞌeguma nima ꞌebeulauina ꞌina paihowega ꞌiꞌabihebeꞌugo ꞌilobwaineya ma ꞌuꞌupwa yahule. Muya geya madouna ꞌeguma wahiu ꞌaigeda tuwa ꞌuloyahule, ma hesi muya madouna ꞌeguma nimau weyahina Yehoba wahiu mabwaiyana ꞌiulesuluhe ꞌasa ꞌalaꞌalatana ꞌoina.
Saꞌila weyahina
Loina nugenugetana ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Ceguma loheya ꞌaigeda nuwanuwana ma mwanena ꞌisaꞌile ꞌina leta loheyaina ꞌida lele ma mwanena ꞌiꞌebwae ma ꞌoinega ꞌisaꞌila.”

content: Ma hesi taugu yahegwaegomi ꞌabehega, ꞌeguma loheya mwanena geya ꞌipui ma tuwa ꞌisaꞌila ma ꞌihaibala hali wahine ꞌoina, loheyaina beno mwanena nugenugetana ꞌiꞌabihepuiya, ꞌeguma wahineina ꞌihaibala hali loheya ꞌoina. Ma loheyaina ꞌeguma ꞌihai wahine saꞌisaꞌilina ꞌoina beno loheyaina wete topui.
Gwae hane weyahina
Wete loina nugenugetana wasanapuya ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Ceguma wagwaehane, sahena ꞌimi gwaeyedi waleꞌwaleꞌwadi, ma hesi Yehoba weyahina wapaihowedi.”

content: Ma hesi taugu ꞌimi gwae hane mabwaiyadi yaꞌausidi. Geyaꞌabwa galewa weyahina wagwaegwae hane nuwana waꞌeꞌetaꞌwataꞌwalulu, weyahina galewa Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebemiya.
Sahena baleꞌu weyahina waꞌeꞌetaꞌwataꞌwalulu, weyahina ꞌahena ꞌana ꞌebelagu, wete sahena Yelusalema weyahina waꞌeꞌetaꞌwataꞌwalulu, weyahina toloina madouna ꞌina ꞌasa.
Wete sahena debau weyahina ꞌuꞌetaꞌwataꞌwalulu, weyahina geya sawasawahiu ma debau ꞌaigeda ꞌuloine ma ꞌiwaꞌeꞌe, nuwana ꞌiduba, ꞌawa?
Ma hesi ꞌeguma gwae moisa, ꞌugwae, “Moisa.” Ma ꞌeguma geya, ꞌugwae “Geya.” Weyahina ꞌeguma gwae ꞌulohepoi, beno Seitani ꞌoinega.
Sahena galana wahehemaise
Loina nugenugetana wasanapu pwaiya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Mata ꞌaigeda ꞌana henimahila mata ꞌaigeda, ma sala ꞌana henimahila sala ꞌaigeda.”

content: Ma taugu yahegwaegomi ꞌabehega sahena wahenimahila, ma hesi ꞌeguma taiya ꞌaseꞌaseu ꞌebeulanega ꞌisapi, sahena ꞌuhehenima hile, ma hesi ꞌaseꞌase ꞌadigeyageyau wete ꞌutagwale ma ꞌisapi.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya heyatala ꞌoinega ꞌa ꞌaleꞌo ꞌiꞌewa, ꞌino sita wete ꞌuꞌebwae.
Ma wete ꞌeguma taiya ꞌihegwaego ma ꞌina tobwatobwa ꞌuꞌahala gogo ꞌaigeda ꞌoinega ma gogo ꞌaigeda ꞌoina, ꞌilobwainegowa ma ꞌupasima ma gogo heluwena wete ꞌoina ꞌutauya.
Ma wete ꞌeguma taiya ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi ꞌoiuwa ginaula ꞌaigeda weyahina, ginaulaina ꞌuꞌebwae, ma sahena ꞌino tobwatobwa ꞌunuwanuwahi.
Helau ꞌada ꞌalehao ꞌoidiya
Gwae nugenugetana wasanapu pwaiya ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Ciyamiyao wahelauwedi, ma hesi ꞌami ꞌalehao waloꞌalehedi.”

content: Ma taugu yahegwaegomi ꞌami ꞌalehao wahelauwedi, ma taudi siꞌabi hemuyemuyegomi weyahidi waꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina ma ꞌiꞌabihetedi.

Bewa ꞌoinega Tamadai galewa ꞌiꞌahwa natunegomi, weyahina tauna helau huhuna, ma tauna wete ꞌina sinala ꞌihalahala togalagala ma tobwebweꞌana ꞌoidiya, ma wete ꞌina dohi ꞌitagwatagwale tobwebweꞌana ma taudi geya tobwebweꞌana ꞌoidiya.
Ma ꞌeguma ꞌiyamiyaomo wahehelauwedi, geya sawasawahina ma maisa Yehoba ꞌoinega waloba, weyahina togalaedi, gide takesi ꞌana toꞌewao, ꞌidi helau gide ꞌomi ꞌimi helau, ꞌiyadiyaomo sihehelauwedi.
Wete ꞌeguma tasimiyaomo waheꞌiyaꞌiyaguwedi geya mumugami hali tomota mumugadi ꞌibwebweꞌana sine, weyahina taudi ganamuli ꞌiyadiyaomo sihehelabinidi, ꞌoinega taudi ma ꞌomi tuwa mumugami mahemahetena.
Ma ꞌomi ꞌilobwainegomiya ma mumugami ꞌausalana mabwaiyana, gide Tamamiu galewa.
